answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The mechanism is sound because grades are sealed and only opened at close, which stops a cluster from coordinating its votes inside a single jury. Consider a harbor as the anchor of the cost.
